The '''nihrotic monstrosity''' was a type of [[Sithspawn|sithspawn]] created by the [[Sith alchemist/Legends|Sith alchemist]] [[Kanoth|Lord Kanoth]] through the use of Kanoth's [[Sith alchemy/Legends|alchemical]] creation, [[nihrot]]. There were many of these kinds of sithspawn present on the [[Unmasked research station]], however they were likely all killed during the station's explosion following Kanoth and [[Dominique|Lady Dominique's]] death at the hands of the [[Alliance Commander]] during the [[mission to the R-4 anomaly]].<ref name="operation" />
